Class JdbcApiKeyCredentialRepository

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.apikey.JdbcApiKeyCredentialRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
ApiKeyCredentialRepository, CredentialRemover
public class JdbcApiKeyCredentialRepository extends Object implements ApiKeyCredentialRepository, CredentialRemover
JDBC implementation of ApiKeyCredentialRepository backed by the who_api_key_credential table. It is also the API key module's CredentialRemover.
